title: Hotel Management Web Application
project_brief: Create a small hotel operations application for reception and management workflows. The system must support rooms, guests, reservations, reservation status changes, and a concise operational overview through a Vue frontend and a Node.js Express API. Persistence may use a deterministic repository fixture for the formal case so the evaluation focuses on workflow completeness, traceability, execution, tests, repair, and User Twin feedback.
constraints: Use JavaScript across browser and server application code
Use Vue for the browser application
Use Node.js and Express for the API
Keep authentication local, simulated, or fixture-backed for the formal case
Do not require a paid external service

definition_of_done.description: Approved requirements cover rooms, guests, reservations, status changes, and operational overview behavior.
Frontend and server install and build steps complete under the WEB_VUE_NODE profile.
Server tests verify representative room, guest, reservation, validation, and status-transition behavior.
Browser tests verify the representative receptionist journey from reservation lookup to status update.
Automated accessibility evidence contains no unresolved critical violation in the evaluated primary workflow.
Receptionist and manager User Twin findings remain independently attributable and conflicts are preserved rather than forced into consensus.
Repairs are bounded and every changed source revision links to triggering deterministic or synthetic evidence.
The approved final package contains source, run evidence, traceability, and final export metadata.
